decision: ACCEPT experimental opt-in C2 substrate and measured residual costs for exact frozen repaired runtime
scope: C2 construction/integration cost disposition only. Current-head hosted default/Windows/required CI and independent/hosted review remain mandatory merge gates; no default promotion, sustained C4, C3 fence removal or parent completion.
why_continue_selected_mode: Actual capture avoids read-triggered rotation and retains coherent immutable bytes/backend/resource owners. Source/ownership/admission/refusal/recovery integration and actual charge drain are verified.

Current matched measurements show a capture and complete-history benefit in these bounded fixtures, while explicitly measuring remaining write/pointer/public-point costs. Those measurements support continuing the experimental implementation graph; they do not qualify workload suitability.

Earlier minimization and source-bound profiles remain historical evidence; this repair restores default classes/capture, fixes Drain and platform contracts, and refreshes all affected capture/read/write/public-MVCC measurements. No older profiler timings or precise causal shares are relabeled as current.
residual_interpretation: Forced-pointer acknowledgement includes real producer flushing and prepared persistent value-log/resource authority before immutable publication. Legacy NoWAL buffering defers its read barrier to capture; raw end-to-end ratios do not isolate tree copying or unique flush cost. Both modes encode the forced-pointer record before acknowledgement; producer flush is not a hidden fsync.

Immutable path/byte ownership, bounded publication/lease preparation, owned codec workspace and existing public MVCC commit/read boundaries remain measured costs. The current matrix quantifies them; source explanation is not a performance pass or a claim of irreducibility.

Material allocation/time gaps remain in every profile, including WAL cases. All absolute values and paired repeats are preserved below and in complete summaries. Near-parity durable timing does not excuse large B/op gaps; undefined zero-allocation ratios retain absolute counts.

Small N/2N rows, 16/128 samples and sequential shared-host runs provide descriptive observations. Spread and decreasing small-N time ratios do not establish O(1), confidence intervals, production tails or significance.
unchanged_guardrails: No threshold/ACK/semantics waiver, sample trimming, observation-only reinterpretation or automatic MVCC/default selection.
Ordinary default raw-path gate remains strict and must pass on the current hosted head. Shared-host native/tiny diagnostic timings are not acceptance.
C3 retains Store fences until accepted/merged M7 #4878 authority; C4 requires landed usable #5019 instrumentation and independently accepted sustained qualification.
